summary: Fractal UI adds AgentTraceCard, a 360px sidebar hover card with a 24 h context histogram (compaction and model-change marks, idle gaps), a cumulative spend line (session vs subagents), a token split bar and compact facts with a subagent table. Each chart renders only when its series is reported; otherwise the section shows the scalar reading and a muted reason such as 'History not retained'. A new trace-bucket type seam (AgentTrace, TraceSeries) lets hosts fill the series as they arrive. A sidebar agent row whose data carries a trace opens this card on hover and focus instead of the compact card.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Additive kit exports and an optional trace field on the sidebar row data. Rows without it render exactly as before.
